name: Bloodmage: Eternal Presence converts damage taken into attack power (#1988)
contract: Eternal Presence 560001: "Increases the attack power of party and raid members by $s1%. Does not stack with similar effects. / In addition, you now gain attack power equal to $s3% of the damage taken for $560010d. Can only occur once every 10 sec." Effects 0 and 1 are SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with auras 166/167 at 5% and already work; that half is asserted here so a fix cannot regress it. Effect 2 is the private aura 354 (nullptr in AuraEffectHandler, SpellAuraEffects.cpp:419) with amount 15 and TriggerSpell 560010, and the record carries ProcFlags 0x0, so 560010 was never cast. 560010's own single effect is aura 99 with a flat amount of 5, so an applied 560010 whose effect value is well above 5 proves the 15% of the damage taken was forwarded. 560010's DurationIndex 1 is 10000 ms, matching the tooltip's "once every 10 sec". Corruption rank 8 (27216) applied to the Bloodmage itself supplies a controlled taken-damage source: AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicDamageAurasTick raises PROC_FLAG_TAKEN_DAMAGE for the victim (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:6584) and its base tick is 150.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Eternal Presence is applied on learn
The raid half already works: attack power is 5% higher
Stay in combat so health regeneration does not interfere
No Eternal Presence buff before any damage is taken
Self Corruption rank 8: a 150 damage tick every 3 sec
DISCRIMINATING: taking damage applies Eternal Presence 560010
The buff carries 15% of the damage taken, not 560010's flat 5
A second tick lands inside the 10 sec internal cooldown
The buff is not refreshed inside its 10 sec internal cooldown
